notes:
What's new in 0.1.128:
- Cast from the browser player: the Cast button now starts a real Google Cast session that sends only the film to your Chromecast or Google TV, from where you were watching, instead of a copy of the whole browser tab; while casting, the page's play, pause and seek controls drive the TV, and stopping puts the page back where the TV got to. Google's Cast script is loaded only when you tap Cast; if it cannot load, the old cast prompt is used.
- Browser player resume: when this browser has a newer spot than the home PC, even one too close to the start or end to offer, the older "Resume from ...?" question is no longer shown and the film starts from the beginning with the intro skip working as usual; Start over at once forgets this browser's saved spot; a player page opened without a household member never reuses a Reconnect spot saved for someone else.
- Browser player: after a seek, an old subtitle line is no longer left on screen while the subtitle list is briefly unavailable; Phone speakers waits for a full second of bad timing before showing Out of sync, also right after the page opens.
- Live TV: recordings with no file can only be removed from the list, while finished recordings can still be deleted; scheduling something that is already scheduled says so even when the recording list is full; a Jellyfin app that asks for the same live channel twice at once uses one tuner, not two.
- Library and metadata: a show named only by a year (such as 1923 or 1883) is looked up by its name instead of as a show that started that year, also from New items and TV Shows; an empty [ ] at the end of an episode file name no longer wipes out the episode title; library search treats punctuation from any language (curly quotes, long dashes and similar) as a space; the Organizer treats a folder you picked to scan as extras only when it is really named Extras, Featurettes, Trailers or Samples, so a picked folder whose name starts with a dot is scanned normally.
- Audiobooks and podcasts: on the PC, when the Library, Series or Reading order view cannot load, the Audiobooks screen now says so instead of staying silent; in the browser, opening a series (or All series) while a search is still pending no longer jumps back to the library list; a podcast speed picked while your settings are still loading no longer erases the speeds saved for your other shows.
- Campsite Mode on the PC: your newest choice of what to share always wins, even if the Wi-Fi or hotspot reconnects while it is being applied, and a slow Share all can no longer fill a room that has since ended or been restarted.
- Movie Night: if the room behind an open Movie Night window has already closed, pressing Movie Night again closes that old window instead of leaving it next to the new one.
- Link a TV: in Account security, signing out a linked TV now also unlinks it from beebo.tv, so it cannot sign straight back in; the screen says whether the unlink was confirmed, or tells you to remove the TV on your phone under Settings > Link a TV. In the browser, only the owner or the member who linked a TV can unlink it this way; anyone else only ends their own session.
- Plain error messages: the Movies, TV Shows, Settings and Users screens no longer show raw computer error text (such as permission codes or [object Object]); they say what to do next, and the technical detail goes to the log.
- Sharing with another household: the share preview says 1 screen or 2 screens correctly.
- Photos, Converter and more: Ctrl + mouse wheel zooms a photo without also zooming the whole Beebo window, and the plain wheel still moves around a zoomed photo; shows moved to the front of the Converter queue one right after another stay in the order you chose; the Remote Desktop viewer keeps showing No picture yet after control is approved if no picture has arrived; on the Users page in the browser, each action button names the person by username or email when they have no display name, so screen readers say who it is for.
- Windows only. The phone app (1.74, build 146) and Beebo Auto (1.22) are separate releases.
- Automated checks: each group of merged changes was tested on the files it touched. In the first group 547 of 549 files passed; the 2 failures came from one change that was then taken out of this release, and both pass without it. In the second group 124 of 124 player, cast and watching-together files passed (one timing-sensitive test passed when run alone), and in the third 54 of 54. Each change had a clear code review (two for protected changes), and the signed installer passed its signature, size, converter, connection-helper and language checks. The full Windows desktop test suite was not run on this release, and no person has installed this version or tried its in-app update yet.
- Release source commit 60da36f67.
